label: Bracket shadow (conf>=0.75, 1 ATR / 1 ATR)
rules: Same Gemini entry signals as main (no extra Gemini call); conf >= 0.75; XAUUSD, EURUSD, US100, XAGUSD only. Fixed bracket at entry: stop 1 M15 ATR, target 1 ATR, 90 min max hold, flat by 21:45 UTC; Gemini CLOSEs ignored. Fill = live quote + 1 tick; exits 1 tick slippage; real commission. Size = floor($900 / 1-ATR risk per contract), max 6 full-size open, one per symbol.
limitation: Main's entry scan skips symbols the MAIN account holds, so the bracket book gets no signal for them while main is in; symbols held only by the bracket book are still scanned. Missed scans are counted per symbol.
